transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today?

I came in because I’ve been feeling really low for a long time. Most days I wake up already feeling heavy, like this gray feeling is on me before I even get to the clinic, and it pretty much stays with me through the day.
How long have you been feeling this way most days?
It’s been about two years and a couple months now. I think it started after the clinic staffing changed and my schedule started rotating all over the place.
Have there been any periods during these two years when you felt better for a couple of months or more, even if it was just a short break from the low mood?

No, not really. It’s been pretty steady since it started, about two years and two months ago, after the staffing changed and my schedule started rotating. I don’t think I’ve had a couple months where it really lifted.
Have you noticed a decrease in your interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy, like hobbies, work, or spending time with loved ones?
I don’t know... I haven’t really noticed that as a separate thing. I mean, I feel low most of the time, but I’m not sure if I’d say I’ve stopped enjoying things specifically.

Can you think back to a specific time recently when you did something you used to enjoy, like a hobby or spending time with someone close to you? Did you feel any pleasure or satisfaction from it, or did it feel like you weren’t getting anything out of it?

I’m not sure. I can’t really think of a clear example where I noticed it one way or the other. I still do some things, but I haven’t been paying attention to whether I actually enjoy them or just get through them.

Can you recall if there have been times in the past two years when you didn’t feel like doing things you used to enjoy, or when those activities didn’t bring you any pleasure, even if you still did them?

I honestly can’t say for sure. I know I’ve felt low a lot, but I haven’t really kept track of whether I didn’t want to do things or whether they just weren’t enjoyable. Nothing specific is coming to mind.

Looking back over the past two years, would you say that there were times when you didn’t feel like doing things you used to enjoy, or when those activities just didn’t feel satisfying, even if you still did them?

I’m still not really sure. I can’t point to a time and say, yeah, I didn’t enjoy that anymore. I know I’ve felt down a lot, but I haven’t really separated that from whether I liked doing things or not.

Looking back, would you say that there were times when you really didn’t feel like doing things you used to enjoy, or when those activities just didn’t feel good or satisfying to you anymore, even if you still did them?

I don’t really know how to answer that. I can’t clearly remember a specific time where I thought, “I don’t enjoy this anymore.” I just know I’ve been kind of going through things, but I haven’t noticed whether it felt satisfying or not.
Looking back, have you noticed that you stopped doing any activities you used to enjoy because they just didn’t feel good or interesting to you anymore?
I don’t think I can say that clearly. I haven’t really noticed, like, stopping something because it stopped feeling good or interesting. I just haven’t paid attention to it that way.
Looking back, have you found that you take less interest in things you used to care about, or that you don’t get the same enjoyment out of life as you used to—even if you still do those things?

I’m honestly not sure. I know I haven’t felt great for a long time, but I can’t really say whether I’ve lost interest in things or if life just feels less enjoyable. I haven’t been paying attention to it that specifically.
Looking back, have you found that activities you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with friends or family, no longer feel pleasurable or rewarding to you—even if you still do them?

I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve noticed it in that exact way, like something used to feel rewarding and now it doesn’t. I know things have felt off for a long time, but I can’t clearly say whether hobbies or time with people stopped feeling pleasurable.
Looking back, have you had times when you used to do something you liked—like a hobby, seeing friends, or watching a show—and it just didn’t feel good or enjoyable anymore, even if you still did it?

I’m still not really sure. I can’t think of a clear example where I was doing something I liked and it suddenly didn’t feel enjoyable anymore. I just know I haven’t been feeling right overall, but I haven’t tracked it like that.
Looking back, have you felt like you were just going through the motions during activities you used to enjoy, even if you kept doing them?

I don’t know if I’d put it that way. I mean, I’ve done things without feeling great, but I haven’t really noticed a clear pattern of just going through the motions with stuff I used to enjoy. It’s hard for me to tell.

Looking back over the past two years, would you say that you’ve lost interest in things you used to care about, or that you just haven’t felt the same enjoyment from them—even if you still do those things?

I’m not sure I can say that, honestly. Over the past couple years things haven’t felt great in general, but I don’t really have a clear sense that I lost interest in specific things I used to care about, or that they stopped being enjoyable. I just haven’t paid attention to it that way.
Looking back, have you noticed that you no longer look forward to things you used to enjoy, or that doing those things just doesn’t feel good anymore—even if you still do them?

I’m still not really sure. I don’t think I’ve clearly noticed that I don’t look forward to things anymore, or that they don’t feel good when I do them. I know I haven’t felt right overall, but I can’t really point to that specifically.
Looking back, have you found that you no longer take pleasure or feel enjoyment in activities you used to like—even if you still do them?

I honestly don’t know. I haven’t really noticed it in that specific way. Like, I can say I haven’t felt good overall, but I can’t clearly say that things I used to like don’t bring me any enjoyment anymore.

Looking back, can you think of any specific activity or thing you used to really enjoy—like a hobby, seeing friends, or something else—that you don’t look forward to or feel good doing anymore, even if you still do it?

I can’t really think of one specific thing, no. Like, I know you’re asking about hobbies or friends, but nothing stands out where I can say, “I used to love that and now I don’t.” I just haven’t noticed it that clearly.
Looking back, have you found that you no longer take pleasure or feel enjoyment in activities you used to like—even if you still do them?
I still can’t really say that, no. I get what you’re asking, but when I look back, I don’t have a clear example where I used to enjoy something and now I don’t. It’s more just… I’m not sure.
Looking back, have you found that you no longer take pleasure or feel enjoyment in activities you used to like—even if you still do them?
I don’t think I can answer that clearly. I haven’t really noticed a specific thing where I used to enjoy it and now I don’t. It’s more just hard for me to tell.
